$description: Three-layer token system for kapil-portfolio. primitive holds raw values and is never referenced from component CSS. semantic holds jobs and is the only layer component CSS may reference. component holds per-widget usage and always resolves to a semantic token, optionally at an alpha. Prose rules live in docs/brand-guidelines.md.

$layers.primitive: Raw values. Named for what they are. Never used directly in component CSS.
$layers.semantic: Named for the job. The only layer authored CSS should reference.
$layers.component: Named for the widget. Resolves to a semantic token or a semantic token at an alpha. Never holds a new hue.

$themes.dark: index.html always, resume.html under prefers-color-scheme: dark. The default.
$themes.light: resume.html only. The site itself has no light theme.

$knownDefect: resume.html ships a separate inline :root using --ink/--soft/--acc/--line/--paper/--wash and --f-d/--f-b/--f-m. Same jobs, different names. Resolution: adopt the semantic names below in both documents and keep the resume's per-theme value overrides. Two accent values are a real requirement, not the defect: #5ee7ff is unreadable on white.

c-ink-950.$description: Deepest ground. Page background on the dark theme.

c-ink-900.$description: One step up from the deepest ground. Raised surfaces and translucent fills.

c-ink-850.$description: Resume dark page wash, sits behind the sheet.

c-ink-880.$description: Resume dark sheet fill. Slightly darker than its wash, inverting the light theme relationship.

c-ink-800.$description: Resume primary text on the light theme.

c-ink-050.$description: Primary text on any dark ground.

c-ink-contrast.$description: Text placed on a cyan fill. Near-black with a blue cast so it reads as part of the accent, not a hole in it.

c-slate-400.$description: Secondary text on the site's dark ground.

c-slate-450.$description: Secondary text on the resume's dark sheet. Lighter than c-slate-400 because that sheet is lighter than the site ground. Keep both.

c-slate-600.$description: Secondary text on the light theme.

c-cyan-400.$description: The signature hue. Work, wayfinding, live state.

c-violet-400.$description: Secondary hue. Structure, enumeration, gradient partner.

c-amber-300.$description: Warm hue. The human register only. See semantic.color.accent-personal.

c-teal-700.$description: Cyan's readable equivalent on white. 5.59:1 on paper.

c-teal-800.$description: Cyan's print equivalent. 8.38:1 on white, survives cheap toner.

c-paper-000.$description: Resume sheet fill, light theme and print.

c-paper-050.$description: Resume page wash, light theme. The sheet sits on it.

c-border-light.$description: Hairline rule on the light theme.

c-border-dark.$description: Hairline rule on the resume's dark theme, where a solid line beats an alpha over a lighter sheet.

c-border-print.$description: Hairline rule in print. Dark enough to survive.

c-white-a09.$description: Hairline rule on the site's dark ground. Alpha so it tracks whatever is behind it.

c-white-a045.$description: Top stop of the standard card gradient.

c-white-a012.$description: Bottom stop of every card gradient. Nearly invisible on purpose.

c-white-a02.$description: Row hover wash in the earlier-work list.

c-print-ink.$description: Print primary text. Pure black, no cast.

max.$description: Content max width. Every section centres inside it.

pad.$description: Horizontal page gutter. The only inline padding value on the site.

ease-out-expo.$description: The site's only custom curve. Fast out, long settle. Used for anything that travels distance.

surface.$description: Page ground. Everything sits on this. Maps to c-ink-950 / c-paper-050.

surface-raised.$description: Anything lifted off the ground: cards, the resume sheet, the stuck nav fill, the marquee band. Maps to c-ink-900 / c-paper-000. On the resume's dark theme the sheet is darker than the wash (#0a0c11 on #10131a), inverting the light relationship.

text-primary.$description: Headings, stat numbers, inline emphasis, anything the reader scans. 17.8:1 on dark surface, 18.4:1 on light.

text-secondary.$description: Body prose, captions, tag text, list items, metadata. The contrast floor of the system at 6.5:1 both themes. Do not introduce anything dimmer.
text-secondary.$note: resume.html dark uses #9aa3b6 instead, tuned for its lighter sheet. Keep that override.

text-on-accent.$description: Text placed on a filled accent surface, such as .btn--primary:hover and ::selection. 13.0:1 on cyan.

border.$description: Every hairline rule and every resting card edge. Borders carry the depth in this system, not shadows.

accent.$description: Primary accent. Means interactive or important: section labels, link hover, active nav, timeline nodes and rule, card hover edge, resume section headings and bullets. Changes value per theme because cyan is unreadable on white.

accent-2.$description: Secondary accent. Means structure or enumeration: card numbers, job list bullets, engagement/offer cards, the cursor blink, and the far stop of every accent gradient. Same value on both themes; 7.4:1 on dark ground.

accent-personal.$description: The human register. Marks content that is Kapil the person rather than Kapil the contractor: the Offline section (YouTube, photography, writing, cooking) and any future personal content. Cyan is the work, violet is the structure, orange is the person.
accent-personal.$doNotUse: Never in the commercial path: hero, offers, pricing, contact CTA, resume. Never as a warning or error colour, it is a register not a severity. If a section can't decide between cyan and orange it belongs in the commercial path and takes cyan.
accent-personal.$exception: component.progress.progress-gradient runs accent to accent-2 to accent-personal across the whole page. That is a map of the document, not a semantic claim.

signal.$description: Live state only: the availability pulse dot, the scroll progress bar, the loader bar. Currently resolves to the same value as accent. Kept as a separate name because accent says 'this is interactive' and signal says 'this is a live status'. They will diverge the first time an error or warning state is needed.

font-display.$description: Names and headlines. Hero title, section titles, card and job titles, stat numbers, contact headline, marquee, logo, quote glyph. Anything scanned rather than read. Never for a paragraph.

font-body.$description: Prose. Paragraphs, list items, blurbs, descriptions. Everything read in sentences.

font-mono.$description: Labels and technical metadata. Section numbers, eyebrows, dates, tags, stat captions, footer, resume section headings. Always letter-spaced, usually uppercase, never a full sentence. This face is what makes the site read as written by an engineer.

text-body.$description: Body base. Set on <body> and inherited.

text-display-hero.$description: Hero name. The largest type on the site, used once.

text-display-contact.$description: Closing headline. Used once, for 'Let's scope it.'

text-display-lead.$description: The about lead sentence. One idea, capped hard at 22ch.

text-display-card.$description: Card, hobby, offer and job titles. Range as shipped is 1.25rem to 1.32rem.

text-prose.$description: In-card and in-list prose. Range as shipped is .93rem to 1.05rem.

text-label.$description: Mono labels. Range as shipped is .66rem to .74rem with tracking .05em to .28em.

space-section.$description: Vertical padding on every section. The largest interval in the system and the reason the page feels unhurried. Do not shrink it to fit more in.

space-gutter.$description: Horizontal page gutter, shared by nav, sections, menu and footer.

space-grid.$description: Gap between cards in every card grid.

space-stack.$description: Gap between paragraphs in a prose block.

space-card-pad.$description: Card interior padding. Top-heavier than bottom, deliberately.

radius-card.$description: The default container shape: .card, .hobby, .offer, .quote. If a new container is not 18px, ask why it is not a card.

radius-portrait.$description: One step softer than a card. Used once, on the portrait frame. Inner image is 23px to sit inside the 1px gradient border.

radius-pill.$description: Anything small-and-clickable or label-like: nav logo, nav CTA, buttons, tags, the offer duration badge.

radius-round.$description: Dots, pulse indicators, avatars, cursor ring.

radius-chip.$description: The 40px hobby icon square. Too small to carry 18px.

ease.$description: The only custom curve. Use for anything with distance. Plain 'ease' is acceptable for opacity fades only.

duration-micro.$description: Colour and border changes on small interactive elements.

duration-hover.$description: Hover transforms, card edges, nav state, backdrop changes. Range as shipped .35s to .45s.

duration-scene.$description: Menu clip-path open, loader dismiss, resume fade-in.

duration-canvas.$description: WebGL canvas opacity. The slowest one-shot on the site.

hover-lift.$description: The maximum hover displacement anywhere on the site.

motion.$reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is respected in style.css and in resume.html and must stay that way. The block collapses animation and transition duration to .01ms, forces revealed content to opacity:1 and transform:none, and dims the WebGL canvas to .5. Every new animated element must be covered by it.
motion.$noJs: Reveal opacity is scoped to .js [data-reveal] so content is visible without JavaScript. Never move the initial opacity:0 out of that scope.

contrast-text-min.$description: Minimum contrast ratio for body text. Every shipped pair clears it; text-secondary at 6.5:1 is the floor.

contrast-large-min.$description: Minimum for large text (24px+, or 19px+ bold) and non-text indicators such as borders, dots and bars.

touch-target-min.$description: Minimum effective interactive target on touch.

focus-visible.$description: Every interactive element needs a visible focus state. This is the current gap: style.css defines hover everywhere and :focus-visible nowhere. Never outline:none without an equal or better replacement.

card-bg.$description: Standard card fill. Near-invisible gradient plus backdrop-filter: blur(10px). Used by .card and .quote.

card-border-hover.$description: Card edge on hover. accent at 40%.

card-glow.$description: Hover shadow. A coloured glow, not a grey drop shadow. Never add a neutral box-shadow to this system.

card-cursor-glow.value: radial-gradient(340px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,50%), rgba(94,231,255,.16), transparent 65%)
card-cursor-glow.$description: Pointer-tracking light on .card::after, driven by --mx/--my from main.js.

card-no-color.$description: The 01/02/03 numerals on project cards. Enumeration is accent-2's job.

label-color.$description: Mono section labels ('01 · Experience'), stack column headings, step numbers, timeline dates, earlier-work tech strings, resume section headings.

label-font.$description: Always mono, always tracked, usually uppercase.

tag-border.$description: Resting pill border on skill tags.

tag-border-hover.$description: Tag border when the parent card or job is hovered. accent at 35%.

tag-text.$description: Tag label at rest; goes to text-primary on parent hover.

offer-bg.$description: Engagement card fill, tinted accent-2 to separate the three paid offers from the neutral project cards.

offer-glow.$description: Engagement card hover glow, violet to match its tint.

offer-len-color.$description: The duration pill ('1 week', '2-4 weeks', 'By feature').

hobby-bg.$description: Offline card fill. The only warm-tinted surface on the site.

hobby-icon-color.$description: The glyph inside the 40px icon square.

hobby-link-color.$description: The 'Watch the channel ->' style links. Tracking widens on hover instead of a colour change.

nav-scrim.$description: Sticky nav fill once scrolled, with backdrop-filter: blur(14px). surface at 72%.

menu-scrim.$description: Full-screen mobile menu fill, with backdrop-filter: blur(20px). Near-opaque so nothing shows through.

nav-link-active.$description: Nav link hovered or matching the section in view.

nav-underline.$description: The 1px rule that grows under an active nav link.

btn-primary-bg.$description: Primary button fill at rest. Near-white, the highest-contrast thing on the page.

btn-primary-text-hover.$description: Primary button label once the fill is cyan.

progress-gradient.$description: Scroll progress bar: accent to accent-2 to accent-personal across the full document. The one sanctioned place all three accents appear together.

loader-gradient.$description: Preloader fill and skill-bar fill. accent to accent-2, no warm stop.

timeline-rule.$description: The 1px vertical rule beside the experience list. Fades out at the bottom so it does not need an end cap.

timeline-node.$description: The 9px ring on each entry. Fills and glows on hover.

timeline-bullet.$description: The small triangle on job bullets.

portrait-frame.$description: 1px gradient border around the photograph, applied as a padded background.

portrait-halo.$description: Blurred glow behind the frame, 20px blur, inset -14%.

portrait-status-dot.$description: The pulsing availability dot in the caption. Live state, so signal not accent.

grain-opacity.$description: Film grain over the whole page. High enough to kill banding, low enough to disappear.

hero-scrim.$description: Gradient between the WebGL particles and the hero copy. Any new background effect needs an equivalent.

hero-scrim-mobile.$description: Same job under 900px, where the copy is centred rather than left-aligned.

marquee-bg.$description: Tech marquee band. surface-raised at 55% with a 6px backdrop blur.

row-hover-bg.$description: Earlier-work row wash on hover, alongside a .9rem padding-left shift.

focus-ring.$description: Required visible focus state for every interactive element. Not yet implemented in style.css. Fix before adding any new interactive component.

selection-text.$description: Selected text colour on that highlight.
